turns.query: For each air quality monitoring station, compute the distance to its nearest fellow air quality monitoring station. Return the top 3 most isolated stations (largest nearest-neighbor distance) with their names and distances in meters.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get all air quality monitoring stations with their coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total stations: {len(stations_df)}")
print(stations_df[['id', 'name_en']])

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Compute nearest neighbor distance for each station using PostGIS
query = text("""
SELECT 
    s1.id,
    s1.name_en,
    MIN(ST_Distance(s1.coordinate::geography, s2.coordinate::geography)) as nearest_distance_meters
FROM air_quality_station s1
JOIN air_quality_station s2 ON s1.id != s2.id
GROUP BY s1.id, s1.name_en
ORDER BY nearest_distance_meters DESC
""")
nearest_distances = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(nearest_distances.head(10))
